IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity_Name__r.Already_Invoiced__c,'Yes'), Opportunity_Name__r.RecordType.Name =='Surveillance'), Opportunity_Name__r.Past_Invoice_Number__c ,
IF( AND( RecordType.Name =='Invoice', ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c,'Proforma Invoice') ), Name,

IF( AND( RecordType.Name =='Invoice', NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Invoice_Status__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c,'Proforma Invoice')), OR( AND(Auto_Generated_Tax_Invoice__c, ISPICKVAL(Initiate_Tax_Invoice_Status__c,'ITI Approved')), !Auto_Generated_Tax_Invoice__c ) ),Service_Code__c+'/'+Opportunity_Name__r.Opp_ICRA_Branch__r.Branch_Code__c +'/'+Bill_Year__c+'/'+TEXT(Billing_Number__c),'')) ))
